executiveSummary: GM0779 passes the deterministic execution contract for all ten canonical presets, T+0/6/12/24/48/72 and all eight essential services. Its 2025 identity, generalized boundary, 21,944 residents, eleven neighbourhoods, three BAG places, six settlement labels and four A27/A59 border links are internally coherent. Current NWB semantics are also correct: the four road corridors affect only Mobility and road-logistics Supply, never the other six services. Release is nevertheless correction-required. The river preset reports 1.807937 normalized inundation stress, 12,716 affected people-equivalent and exact eight-service availability at T+24 without selecting an Amer/Bergsche Maas/Donge hydrograph, defence state, breach/overtopping mode, connected footprint, depth, arrival or recession; at T+72 flood stress and severity remain unchanged while affected population increases to 13,667. Eight unrelated hazard families reuse one exact neighbourhood ranking and GM0779 has no municipality-specific unsupported-spatial guard, so the browser presents precise neighbourhood patches as derived-screening. Live official HWH/DAMO queries find thirteen surface-water pumps, twenty-one weirs, four sluices and four sewer pumps inside the full boundary while the deployment cache assigns zero water assets. Current REV data find thirty-nine regulated activities inside the boundary, including VARO Energy Terminal and RWE Generation as Seveso activities, yet there is no industrial-release mechanism. The model also omits Amercentrale's regional electricity, heat and inland-shipping dependencies, the external RWZI, incident-time A27/A59/Keizersveer access and out-of-municipality acute care. Public registers and observations can improve typed context, but they do not disclose live utility topology, state, capacity, backup or resources. Current observations, planning records, official scenarios and synthetic T+72 output must remain distinct, and NoData must never become zero or safe.

Reference point [4.878371243973133, 51.69717799549355] lies inside the generalized boundary; the current full PDOK boundary is one MultiPolygon component with 684 coordinate positions and bounding box [4.823610411152654, 51.67183546130774, 4.933169421303784, 51.72014879368784].

geography.summary: Administrative geography is coherent, but it is not hydraulic, industrial-effect, utility, heat-network or emergency-access geography.
notes: Eleven CBS neighbourhoods and three districts support aggregation; three BAG places and six BRT settlement labels preserve Geertruidenberg, Raamsdonksveer, Raamsdonk and smaller-place context.

Official sources distinguish the Bergsche Maas/Amer, Donge, Wilhelminakanaal/Amertak, primary and regional defences, polders, industrial terrains, Amercentrale, Hooipolder and Keizersveer. Those mechanisms cannot be derived from a municipality centroid or neighbourhood hash.

The overview boundary has 48 positions versus 684 in the current full boundary. It is appropriate for national selection, not parcel hydraulics, exact water-object inclusion, plume modelling or route passability.

HWH/DAMO points, REV activity points, flood/terrain rasters, roads, waterways and provider polygons each have different scale, time and completeness; one source never establishes another source's topology or state.

demography.summary: Headline population and aggregate vulnerability inputs agree with CBS 2025 and neighbourhood totals reconcile within publication rounding.
notes: Eleven independently rounded neighbourhood rows sum to 21,940 residents, four below the municipality total (-0.018 percent); they sum to 9,835 households and 5,065 residents aged 65 or older.
Largest neighbourhoods are Raamsdonksveer 6,790, Hooipolder en De Hoeven 5,615, Geertruidenberg-Kom 2,985, Geertruidenberg-West 2,415 and Raamsdonk 2,105.
Age, household form, car access, density and GP/supermarket distance are aggregate context, not individual medical dependence, daytime presence, evacuation need, preparedness or priority.
Workers at Amer/Dombosch, commuters, visitors, care recipients, responders and displaced people are not represented by resident allocation.

regionalDetail.summary: Eleven neighbourhoods provide useful context, but partial fields and hazard-independent allocation prevent operational prioritization.
notes: All eleven rows carry core population, household, address-density, land/water and proximity inputs. Average home value covers 9/11, cars per household 7/11, disability/old-age/social-assistance shares 8/11 and housing/tenure 10/11.
District-heating share and public-charging count cover 0/11 and correctly remain null. Missing, suppressed, unavailable and not-applicable values are not calculated zeros.
Official context distinguishes heat stress in parts of Raamsdonksveer and Geertruidenberg, primary-defence projects and industrial activities, but none drives local allocation.
Population, affected population and every service demand/delivery total reconcile, yet eight unrelated nonzero hazards retain the same exact eleven-neighbourhood order.

settlements.summary: Three BAG woonplaatsen and six BRT settlement labels preserve municipal place context without fabricating service districts.
notes: BAG places are Geertruidenberg, Raamsdonk and Raamsdonksveer; BRT labels additionally include De Bergen, De Laan and Het Broek.

transport.summary: Physical A27/A59 identities and road-only service scope are coherent, but internal crossings, waterways, transit operation and incident-time continuity are absent.
notes: Four generated links connect GM0779 to Altena, Oosterhout and Waalwijk: A27 to Altena, A27 to Oosterhout and A59 to Oosterhout/Waalwijk. All sixteen source wvk ids are unique and physicalCorridorId resolves to NWB-road-27 or NWB-road-59.
The engine exposes these routes only to Mobility and Supply, and zero to power, water, drainage, gas, telecom and facilities. This is the correct NWB semantic safeguard.

The official regional profile identifies Hooipolder as the A27/A59 junction and warns that bridge incidents affect diversions and emergency access. The current A27 Houten-Hooipolder works include Hooipolder and Keizersveer-related structures, but a project or past closure is not current incident state.

No ProRail station lies inside the boundary and 24 scheduled transit stop areas do. Static road, GTFS and waterway geometry does not establish service, vehicle/vessel availability, evacuation throughput, passability or repair access.
The deployed NDW snapshot has no assigned GM0779 record. That is a filtered no-match, never proof that the A27, A59, bridges, local streets or approaches are open now or through T+72.

emergencyContext.summary: Strong public water, energy, industrial, provider and telecom context exists, but the deployment omits material water objects and no source supplies complete live topology or resources.
notes: Live full-boundary HWH queries find thirteen surface-water pumps, twenty-one weirs and four sluices; DAMO finds four sewer pumps. The deployment water-assets cache assigns zero objects to GM0779, which is a refresh/contributor/geometry gap rather than absence.

No RWZI falls inside the exact boundary in the live DAMO check; RWZI Dongemond lies outside in Oosterhout. This establishes a possible cross-boundary water-chain dependency for investigation, not a proven flow connection or operational state.

The live REV WFS returns thirty-nine regulated activities inside the boundary, including VARO Energy Terminal Geertruidenberg and RWE Generation NL B.V. as Seveso activities, five natural-gas treatment/control/measurement activities, LPG and propane activities. Register presence is not a current incident, material inventory, plume or failure probability.

Mijn Aansluiting identifies Enexis electricity/gas, Brabant Water and Ziggo at the reference point; drainage has no feature. Provider polygons are responsibility context, not complete coverage, topology, capacity, outage or restoration.

One NBNL sample describes GT Geertruidenberg planning constraints/queues and nineteen projects; one fresh Keizersveer Waterinfo level observation is 31 cm NAP at 2026-09-02T17:30:00Z. Neither is live load/topology or a municipality-wide hydraulic surface/T+72 forecast.

The deployment assigns 46 RDI antenna installations, ten DUO education records and no RIVM acute-care location to GM0779. Counts do not establish coverage, emergency role, staffing, stock, backup, access or availability; zero acute care means no listed in-boundary record, not no care dependency.

notes: Peak municipal severities are storm 0.700678, pluvial 0.358358, river 0.560720, coastal 0.038400, heat 0.632125, winter 0.708095, cyber 0.592870, earthquake 0.007478, wildfire 0.099758 and compound 0.934601.
River T+24 flood stress is 1.807937 and remains 1.807937 at T+72; current severity also stays 0.560720 while pressure rises to 0.582062 and affected population to 13,667.

Compound T+24 carries 56.419378 mm/h rain, 0.400168 flood stress, 31.803034 m/s wind and 0.520124 cyber disruption. At T+72 current severity is 0.437714 while flood stress, pressure, affected population and all eight availability values remain exactly unchanged.

Coastal T+24 has zero direct flood and 18.19999 m/s wind. That scoped zero is not an all-clear for Amer/Bergsche Maas surge-discharge interaction, canal/polder water or drainage; it is an indirect generic wind exercise.

Canonical wildfire has zero direct flame at T+24 with smoke 0.218174 and drought 0.467694; canonical earthquake has zero current shaking at T+24. Those zeros do not test another local source or unmodelled hazard.
All outputs are deterministic exercise assumptions, not observations, warnings, probabilities, industrial intelligence, outages or forecasts.

numericalInvariants.summary: Finite bounds, determinism, exact no-event behavior, cumulative burden, road-service scope, local reconciliation and layer invariance pass.
notes: MUNICIPALITY_AUDIT_CODE=GM0779 pnpm audit:model passed both focused tests across 10 presets × 6 checkpoints × 8 services; the initial run completed in 35.46 seconds with 35.26 seconds of test execution.
Every zero-intensity preset produces exact zero current severity, peak severity, affected population and event-attributable essential-service person-hours at every checkpoint.
Repeated frames are deterministic; values are finite and bounded; cumulative event-attributable essential-service person-hours are monotonic; logical route flow stays within effective capacity.
T+24 local population, affected population and every service demand/delivery ledger reconcile. Maximum observed local, demand and delivery floating-point discrepancy is 7.105427357601002e-15.
Changing among all eleven map layers leaves hazard/pressure/affected output unchanged; maximum local layer hazard delta is zero.
All eight pressure weights participate and sum to one; operations multipliers and household preparedness remain bounded scenario assumptions rather than inferred public facts.

spatialPlausibility.summary: A shared neighbourhood hash, unselected river field and absent GM0779 support guard create false local precision.
notes: At audit time packages/sim-core/src/model.ts:4361 derives hazardSeed from city seed, scenario seed and region id; packages/sim-core/src/model.ts:4373 applies it locally. Hazard family, source containment, terrain, land cover, water pathway and selected public surface are absent.

Severe storm, pluvial, river, coastal, heat, winter, cyber and wildfire all rank Industrieterrein Dombosch, Raamsdonksveer and Geertruidenberg-West first through third at T+24; Dombosch has only 35 residents. Compound retains the same ordering with clipping; earthquake is zero at T+24.

A deliberately artificial wildfire source [4.856814, 51.710617] lies in Industrieterrein Dongeoever Amerkant. At T+24 it produces 0.487591 direct fire, but its containing neighbourhood ranks seventh at 0.461019 while Dombosch ranks first at 0.546846. This proves the source coordinate does not control local ordering; it is not evidence of an actual or eligible ignition.

The public combustible-nature WFS bbox query returns neighbouring Drimmelen/Oosterhout polygons but no GM0779-held polygon. Absence in this coverage is Unknown, not proof of no fuel or zero wildfire risk; canonical smoke can also be indirect.
GM0779 has no entry in auditedUnsupportedSpatialNotes, so the browser shows exact local polygons under evidence class derived-screening rather than a selected-municipality unsupported warning.
Official flood, defence, climate, industrial and elevation layers are rendered as non-causal context and are not sampled by local allocation.

Compound T+24/T+72 availability remains exactly power 0.230748, water 0.334353, drainage 0.271362, gas 0.525903, telecom 0.211088, mobility 0.414284, facilities 0.292759 and supply 0.554526.

Live HWH/DAMO registers expose managed-water objects and a likely external treatment dependency for investigation, but not catchment connectivity, flow direction, compatible units, controls, usable capacity, power/backup or restoration.

RWE describes Amercentrale electricity production, regional heat supply and biomass delivery/storage by inland ship. The current model has no electricity-generation, district-heat, fuel-port, shipping or cross-boundary heat consumer node.

Provider territories, one NBNL sample, RDI sites, DUO records, REV points and Waterinfo are context only and correctly do not affect simulation. No safe physical feeder, pipe, sewer, backhaul, stock or live state is inferred from roads or points.

causalTrace.summary: Cause contributions, dependencies, counterfactuals and logical-proxy metadata reconcile, but local driver magnitudes and interventions remain unvalidated assumptions.
notes: Municipal pressure uses transparent weights power 0.18, water 0.15, drainage 0.08, gas 0.09, telecom 0.12, mobility 0.12, facilities 0.14 and supply 0.12; focused tests close the ledger.
The UI identifies scenario evidence and calls road-based transfers logical proxies rather than physical utility topology.

An internally exact causal trace explains model arithmetic; it cannot validate an omitted Amer/Donge water path, pumping catchment, generation/heat dependency, industrial release, bridge access, external care or restoration resource.

The VRMWB plans identify conditional decisions such as source/effect-zone assessment, weather and safe access, water/soil/air contamination, water-intake protection, logistics, open-water firefighting, contaminated fire-water management and possible pump/shipping measures. These are doctrine, not confirmed actions or inventories for this exercise.

Demand, capacity, backup, repair, preparedness, generator priority and mutual-aid effects remain bounded/time-gated scenario assumptions and must never be described as actual crews, assets, operator commitments or household behavior.

recovery72h.summary: The T+0–72 paths present exact persistence, recovery or deterioration without event-specific hydraulics, actions, access, resources or operator commitments.
notes: River T+24 to T+72 keeps severity 0.560720 and flood stress 1.807937; seven service availabilities remain exact while facilities drops, pressure rises 0.551269 to 0.582062, affected population rises 12,716 to 13,667 and cumulative unmet essential-service burden rises 216,963.86 to 865,421.14 person-hours.

Compound T+24 to T+72 keeps pressure 0.656698, affected population 15,975 and every availability value exact while severity declines 0.923867 to 0.437714; cumulative burden reaches 950,883.50 person-hours.

No selected hydrograph, defence/breach state, pump/control state, plume, A27/A59/bridge/waterway access, heat contingency, acute-care destination, shelter/supply stock, crew/material, backup endurance or restoration schedule supports those exact paths.

The regional crisis and Seveso plans establish roles and conditional actions. Waterboard projects, RWE plans, NBNL projects and road works are dated planning context, not proof an action is available, dispatched, effective or complete at a scenario checkpoint.
Current Waterinfo, KNMI and NDW records must remain observation/replay context at their own valid time; none may be extrapolated into T+72 without an explicit forecast or scenario transformation.

findings.summary: The complete deterministic municipality contract, reconciliation and road-only service-scope safeguards pass.
findings.evidence: The focused gate executes 10 presets × 6 checkpoints × 8 services, checks exact zero-intensity behavior, determinism, bounds, monotonic event-attributable burden, local demand/delivery reconciliation, all eight pressure contributions and layer invariance. Four A27/A59 NWB links appear only for Mobility and Supply; all six other route sets are empty and every transfer is labelled logical-proxy.
findings.action: Retain the focused gate, exact physical corridor/wvk provenance, service-specific supportedServices rule, logical-proxy wording and the distinct scenario/official-context/observed evidence classes in all future corrections.

findings.summary: The generalized overview boundary and neighbourhoods are valid aggregation geography but unsuitable for local hydraulics or asset containment.
findings.evidence: E01's current full boundary has 684 coordinate positions versus 48 in the overview. Full-boundary point-in-polygon changes water/industrial inclusion at the Amer, Donge, canals and municipal edges. Administrative polygons carry no water connectivity, defence, industrial effect, heat-service or road-passability semantics.
findings.action: Keep the overview for selection and aggregation. Use versioned full official geometry for audit/asset containment and authority-supplied hydraulic/effect/service geometries for scenario computation. Show boundary edition/generalization and never infer state from polygon membership alone.

E02 describes multi-day Benedenrivieren discharge/surge and cascading systems; E03 identifies GENDO and WAD primary defences. No gauge hydrograph/datum, surge-discharge combination, defence state, breach/overtopping, connected footprint, depth, arrival, duration, recession or pump/dewatering state is selected. findings.action: Release gate: mark GM0779 river/coastal local output unsupported until an authority-reviewed versioned event selects Amer/Bergsche Maas/Donge/Wilhelminakanaal boundary conditions, defence and failure state, connected footprint, depth units, arrival/duration/recession and NoData. residualLimitations: VRMWB plans establish regional risk mechanisms, roles and doctrine, not a current incident, forecast, probability, resource inventory or municipality-specific loss calibration.

No reviewed source selects an Amer/Bergsche Maas/Donge hydrograph, datum-aligned threshold, defence/failure state, connected inundation footprint, arrival, duration, recession or dewatering path for this exercise.

HWH/DAMO and REV object counts are retrieval-time register results and can change; contributors may be incomplete or non-harmonized, and geometry membership does not establish function, connectivity or operating state.
The GENDO page says the segment is currently safe enough despite not meeting a future standard; the project must not be shown as an existing failure or guaranteed future schedule.

RWE and Powerport sources are operator/planning context. Published household equivalents, network size and proposed assets are not live load, physical topology, black-start capability, fuel stock, outage or restoration promise.

Provider polygons identify responsibility at one query point only. No reviewed public source supplies safe, complete and current feeder, pipe/valve, pressure-zone, sewer-catchment, heat-network, telecom-backhaul, backup, stock, crew or restoration topology.

The single Keizersveer Waterinfo value is timestamped point context, not a continuous hydraulic surface, threshold outside the named point, breach, depth, forecast or T+72 input; Waterinfo is not mission-critical.

NBNL capacity data are one large-user planning sample and cannot be extended to household service, live load, outage, switching, emergency reserve or recovery. Its exact dataset licence/API stability remain unresolved.
RDI antenna, DUO education and RIVM care records do not establish operator/service coverage, emergency role, occupancy, staff, stock, backup, access, state or restoration.

NWB, FIS and GTFS are physical/scheduled context and do not establish incident-time road, bridge, lock, bus, vessel, evacuation, ambulance, clearance or repair operation. Zero NDW records is no all-clear.
The combustible-nature WFS returning no GM0779-held polygon is a coverage result, not proof of no fuel or zero fire risk; an artificial source test is diagnostic and not an event claim.
The one transient REV tile network error was not reproducible in the first browser run and produced no bad HTTP status; external overlay availability must remain separate from simulation status.
